summary: Verified Pro Editor Phase-a end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass (logo upload/fetch, prefs persist, edit reframe 16:9->9:16 cinematic, edit 1:1 warm with logo overlay, faststart mp4 + Range 206, delete edit job, 404 on missing job). Frontend: opened editor from Edit(Pro) button on the seeded admin-demo-vid card, all controls (aspect 16:9/9:16/1:1, filters, speed, logo upload/toggle/pos-grid/size/opacity/x-y sliders) present and interactive, preview aspect-class + CSS filter update live, PNG logo upload -> live overlay preview, export created a NEW edit job (kind='edit', aspect_ratio='9:16') that was prepended to My Generations. Social page captions render with text-base class. 24/26 frontend checks pass; 2 flagged failures are false-negatives / minor UX (see notes).

integration_issues.issue: Backend POST /api/video/jobs/{id}/edit returned 200 and a new edit job appeared in /api/video/jobs (n went 1->2, correct aspect_ratio=9:16), but during my 120s poll the editor modal did not always close within the window. Not reproducible via API. Likely axios reject on transient Cloud Run/proxy hiccup (a 502 console error was observed for an unrelated resource fetch during ffmpeg). Consider showing progress and using onDone success even on network-level errors when the job list refresh reveals the new edit.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In VideoEditor.doExport(), on axios error, still refresh job list and if a new edit job appears within a few seconds, close modal + toast success instead of error. Prevents ghost 'Export failed' toasts when the request actually succeeded server-side.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 983 lines (>700 threshold). Time to split into routers (video, editor, files, social, admin).

video edit endpoint loads the entire source mp4 + writes entire output into memory (Path.write_bytes / read_bytes) then re-uploads. For long videos this doubles memory pressure. Consider streaming to/from temp files without materialising full bytes when possible (or bounded chunk copies).
GET /api/me/logo has no Cache-Control set; adding e.g. 'private, max-age=300' will help live-preview perf when moving sliders (the ?b= cache-buster in the JSX already forces re-fetch on upload).

PUT /api/me/preferences ignores unknown fields silently; no explicit validation on ranges (x/y/scale/opacity in [0,1]); backend does clamp in transform_video, but persisted prefs could store out-of-range values.

Editor export does not disable close-on-backdrop while busy? Actually it does check `!busy` for backdrop click, but the X button (editor-close) is not guarded — clicking X mid-render abandons the edit but backend still completes and writes the new job (harmless but confusing).
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded admin-demo-vid (owner=user_admin_seed). Created & deleted 2 edit jobs during pytest and 1 during browser test (one remains in DB from browser test if delete-dialog handler missed the confirm — id logged in test output).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase-a editor testids used by tests: video-edit-{id}, video-delete-{id}, video-editor, editor-preview, editor-aspect-16:9|9:16|1:1, editor-filter-{name}, editor-speed-{n}, editor-logo-upload, editor-logo-file (hidden input), editor-logo-toggle, editor-logo-preview, editor-logo-pos-{x}-{y}, editor-logo-size, editor-logo-opacity, editor-logo-x, editor-logo-y, editor-export, editor-close. Backend tests: pytest backend/tests/test_video_editor_pipeline.py (7/7). ffmpeg one-pass takes ~30-70s for a 6s Veo clip on this container. Video preview cannot be pixel-decoded in headless Chromium (missing proprietary codecs) — verify via style/class assertions like this iteration did.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found. Only observation: the edit modal's onClose depends on axios success; if the front-end network layer sees a transient error while backend still succeeds, user gets a false 'Export failed' toast even though the new edit job is queued. Mitigation described in action_items.
